g.text: Legend: H human · L LLM agent · S skill, a written procedure the LLM follows · T tool, deterministic code · thick edge does the work · dashed, an extension · ❚❚ a checkpoint where the agent waits for the human.
solution-planner runs every card: it calls each tool by name, reads cards, never writes coordinates.
(3.6) Or minima hopping with the MLIP
❚❚ pick up to five final states
supplies the surface, the adsorbates and a description; answers the five
computational-chemist: runs the Formulate interview, writes PROJECT.md
literature-reader: fetches E_ads and d with their sources for the human
literature_lookup: published E_ads and the bond length d, with source,
computational-chemist: proposes the settings lock and states the
structure_retrieval and calculation_protocol: the three relaxed inputs,
A and B by cleaving the named bond, the cell; settings locked in
mlip-specialist: chooses the potential from the benchmark and records
scientific-critic: reviews the plan before the human approves it
mlip_selection: two or three candidates benchmarked on the system class;
the chosen one relaxes, all form the committee of step 7
site_enumeration: symmetry-inequivalent sites, fcc and hcp apart,
anomaly_filter, check 10: the A–B bond re-formed after relaxation; runs
literature-reader: supplies d, the length of the bond to break, with its
pair_enumeration: every symmetry-distinct A–B pair in [1.5 d, 5] Å,
nearest first by site-graph distance, counted; d from literature_lookup
pull_force_screen: one MLIP force call per pair; a pull towards the
other fragment queues the pair last
surface-chemist: proposes a site type per fragment from the chemistry of
the cleavage, orders the list; never overrides a check
surface-chemist reads descriptor_card text, proposes a site type and
orientation per fragment, reorders; never edits coordinates
deferred: later; the team decides how; A stays at its initial-state site
adsorbate_placement: A at every symmetry-distinct site near its old
site, counted; A fixed is the cheap baseline
minima_hopping: NEBscape's endpoint generator with the chosen MLIP, the
relaxation: relax every pair with the chosen MLIP and the locked
extension: surface-chemist: comments on cards, never overrides
anomaly_filter: nine checks per fragment plus two final-state checks,
before and after relaxation; verdict into the card; rejections logged
soap_clustering: SOAP clusters of the survivors; the nearest and the
mlip-specialist: decides trust, repair or escalate from the calibrated
extension: agentic uncertainty: N planner runs; dft_single_points if D2
uncertainty_estimation: committee disagreement across the 1* candidates,
calibrated on DFT or OC20NEB labels; doubt escalates
picks up to five on the cards; choice and reason to the case bank
solution-planner: shows the cards with rank, doubt and verdicts
ranking: nearest first, then energy; one descriptor_card per final state
with doubt and verdicts; the human picks; choice and reason to
scientific-critic: reviews the report in its own context before the
reference_energies and report: E(FS near), E(FS ∞) from separate cells,
rejections with reasons, recombination rate, decision trace
Who does what, step by step: one card per board step; inside it, the human, the LLM agent, the skill and the tool that act, the thick edge does the work

board of 21 October 2026 · three phases left to right, cards top to bottom · ❚❚ a checkpoint where the agent waits · dashed: an extension; a dashed card: a step deferred, on the board but commented out of the code
tool names are the functions under src/fragplace/tools/, skills the folders under skills/, agents the files under agents/
